<insights>
- Steve Burton was nominated for the Soap Opera Digest Award in 1997 for Outstanding Younger Lead Actor in General Hospital.
- He was nominated again in 1998 for the same category.
- In 1999, he won the Soap Opera Digest Award for Hottest Male Star in General Hospital.
- He continued to be nominated for the Soap Opera Digest Award until 2003.
</insights>

<answer>
The earliest year that actor Steve Burton was nominated for his work on General Hospital by the Soap Opera Digest Award Association was 1997.
</answer>
